article.title: Bailee’s responsibility when goods are not duly returned. 1
article.content: If, by the default of the bailee, the goods are not returned, delivered or tendered at the proper time, he is responsible to the bailor for any loss, destruction or deterioration of the goods from that time.2
article.html:
161Bailee’s responsibility when goods are not duly returned.1

Section 161 · Chapter IX · page 40 of the Act

If, by the default of the bailee, the goods are not returned, delivered or tendered at the proper time, he is responsible to the bailor for any loss, destruction or deterioration of the goods from that time.2

Page 40

1 S. 161 has been declared to apply to the responsibility of the Trustees of the Port of Madras as to goods in their possession seethe Madras Port Trust Act, 1905 (Madras Act 2 of 1905).

2 As to Railway contracts, see the Indian Railways Act, 1890 (9 of 1890), s. 72.

Page 41

1 See the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (1 of 1872), s. 117.
